overall: Violation found: the Board failed to create minutes for three 2014 meetings and failed to timely approve minutes for all five; the AG ordered compliance, minute creation and approval, and certification within 30 days.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly failed to create and maintain minutes for several 2014 meetings; handwritten notes were never converted into draft minutes.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find the Board violated the Open Meeting law by failing to create and maintain minutes of the February 2, March 26, and April 7 meetings.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly failed to review and approve minutes of five 2014 meetings in a timely manner.
allegations.key_passage: No matter which regulatory standard we apply, the Board has failed to approve the minutes of all five meetings in a timely manner.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Create and approve minutes for the February 26, March 26, and April 1, 2014 meetings, to the best of its ability using the notes it provided, within 30 days.
Approve the minutes of the June 25, 2014 and July 15, 2014 meetings within 30 days.
Certify compliance to the AG on the attached form within 30 days of receipt of the letter.
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the law, and caution the Board that a future similar violation may be considered evidence of an intentional violation of the law.
